rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound describing the enclosures characterized by pairs/groups of five, eight, and sixteen; agrees with the goddess described in the preceding verses
compound describing residence in the six-cornered figure and the square; final member -ga forms an accusative feminine singular agreeing with the goddess

items.question: Which geometric enclosures of the Śrīcakra serve as the dwelling of the described goddess?
premises: The goddess is associated with enclosures characterized by five, eight, and sixteen pairs.
The goddess is associated with a six-cornered figure and a square.
items.inference: The described goddess resides within the specific geometric enclosures of the Śrīcakra defined by these numerical and figural forms.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the five, eight, and sixteen pairs within the Śrīcakra structure are not explicitly specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: She dwells in the enclosures of five, eight, and sixteen pairs, and in the six-cornered figure and the square.
